goal: I want a simple sustainable strength-training habit. I am new to lifting and want resistance training only.
openingMessage: I'd like a {{planSpanWeeks}}-week beginner strength plan, prescribing only the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks now.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Establish a strength habit without invented endurance goals or measured maxima.
reviewAnchors.progression: Use a zero recent strength baseline; do not import an experienced lifting dose.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Separate manageable strength days and include rest between sets.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Named exercises, set/repetition completions, rests and understandable RIR or RPE; no strength zone calibration.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Use accessible dumbbells/machines/bodyweight, respect limited technique experience and time.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Explain starting-weight selection without pretending to know supplied working weights.
